ad.title: Financial Controller
ad.description:
Responsibilities

Reporting to the CFO, the Financial Controller (“FC”) is responsible for group-level financial control, statutory and management reporting, governance, and compliance across Far East Orchard Limited (“FEOR”) and its subsidiaries.

 

1.    Group Financial Reporting & Close
•    Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close at group level, ensuring adherence to reporting timelines and accounting standards.
•    Oversee group consolidation and ensure accuracy of eliminations and group journals.
•    Review and support the preparation of statutory and management financial statements and analyses.
•    Coordinate and direct the preparation of regulatory reporting, including quarterly and year-end reporting to SGX.
•    Ensure financial statements are prepared in accordance with applicable accounting standards, SGX requirements, and group accounting policies.

 

2.    Governance, Controls & Compliance
•    Establish and maintain strong group financial controls, ensuring consistency and discipline across entities and regions.
•    Review and sign off group-level compliance and Negative Assurance Checklists (NACs), and oversee entity-level compliance reviews.
•    Act as the primary finance counterpart for external auditors, internal audit, and regulators, managing audit planning, execution, and issue resolution.
•    Ensure compliance with accounting standards, loan covenants, and regulatory requirements across jurisdictions.
•    Ensure compliance with interested person transaction (IPT) requirements and related disclosures.

 

3.    Budgeting, Forecasting & Management Reporting
•    Oversee the preparation and review of annual group budgets and rolling forecasts (P&L, cash flow, and capex), including coordination and review of business units’ budgets; analyse and report variances.
•    Review consolidated forecasts, key assumptions, and performance drivers.
•    Review management reports, variance analyses, and performance commentary for CFO and EXCO review.
•    Provide financial insight and analysis to support strategic initiatives, investment decisions, and capital allocation.

 

4.    Treasury, Tax & Risk Oversight
•    Oversee treasury management and reporting, liquidity monitoring, and covenant compliance.
•    Oversee tax team, including filings and compliance matters and coordination with external tax advisors.
•    Support the CFO in financial risk identification, mitigation, and scenario analysis as required.

 

5.    Stakeholder & Board Support
•    Support the CFO in the preparation of Board and ARC papers, including financial results, audit matters, accounting judgments, and governance disclosures.
•    Act as a key finance point-of-contact for senior management, auditors, and key external stakeholders on group-wide financial reporting and control matters.
•    Contribute to group initiatives, business integration, and finance transformation projects as required.

 

6.    Finance Leadership & Capability Building
•    Lead and develop the finance team, including Controllers/Managers and shared service teams where applicable.
•    Provide clear oversight, coaching, and performance management to ensure high professional standards.
•    Drive continuous improvement in financial reporting processes, systems, and controls.
•    Support finance transformation initiatives, including systems upgrades and standardisation efforts.
•    Foster a strong culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Degree in Accountancy or related discipline
  • Professional accounting qualification (e.g. CA, ACCA, or equivalent)
  • Minimum 10–12 years of relevant finance experience; ideally with 8–10 years in a Big 4 accounting firm
  • Experience of working in a SGX-listed group, real estate, hospitality, or lodging businesses is a definite advantage
  • Strong knowledge and experience in financial reporting standards, consolidations, and internal controls
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; meticulous and detail-oriented
  • Ability to interpret complex financial information and communicate clearly to senior management and board members
  • High integrity and firm on controls
  • Able to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels
  • Confident in managing senior stakeholders and external advisors
  • Calm under pressure, with sound judgment in sensitive and time-critical matters
  • Proven leadership in a similar setting
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills
  • Good business acumen and highly adaptive
  • Mature, proactive, resourceful and hands-on with good initiative
  • Works well independently with minimal supervision, while remaining a strong team player
  • Able to multitask and deliver under multiple tight deadlines

ad.title: Regional AI Video Content Manager
ad.description:
Who we are

Intrepid Asia is a leading Ecommerce and Digital Solutions Provider in South East Asia. We offer end-to-end omni-channel ecommerce management, Livestreaming, Video production & Affiliate Management for Social Commerce plus full funnel Digital Marketing Services and advanced Market Intelligence, all powered by state of the art inhouse Technology to our client base of leading international brands across all key marketplaces and social platforms in all 6 SEA countries. By joining us, you will work on the cutting edge of digital and social commerce in SEA, and experience what it takes to drive a successful ecommerce business end-to-end.

The Social Commerce Team is a fast-growing team leading the way in livestream selling, short video content, and affiliate marketing across Southeast Asia. We work with top brands, combining creativity, data, and platform expertise to drive real commercial results. As part of Intrepid’s end-to-end eCommerce ecosystem, we gain broad exposure across operations, collaborate with cross-functional experts, and play a key role in shaping how brands connect with digital shoppers in real time.


The part you will play

Intrepid Asia is seeking a forward-thinking Regional AI Video Content Manager to lead the transformation of video production through artificial intelligence, agentic AI, and automation.

This role blends creative storytelling with machine learning capabilities to accelerate end-to-end video production across Southeast Asia. You will drive AI adoption within the regional video team, standardize workflows, and enable scalable, high-quality content creation for eCommerce and social commerce brands.


You are not just a video expert. You are a systems thinker who sees AI as a multiplier — improving speed, consistency, insights, and creative performance.


As a Regional AI Video Content Manager, you will take charge of:

AI-Led Video Production Strategy

  • Standardize livestream production quality across brands by implementing consistent technical configurations and setups.
  • Work closely with hosts and Social Commerce Account Managers to deliver engaging and seamless livestream experiences.

Studio & Equipment Management

  • Maintain full studio readiness, including equipment organization, cleanliness, and functional setup for livestream sessions.
  • Manage studio inventory including cameras, lighting equipment, audio systems, props, and product samples.
  • Track equipment usage and conduct routine maintenance to ensure all production equipment remains in optimal working condition.
  • Plan and supervise equipment upgrades or purchases to support evolving livestream production needs.
  • Conduct daily and weekly technical checks to minimize last-minute issues before livestream sessions.

Livestream Quality Optimization

  • Identify recurring technical issues during livestream sessions and implement preventive solutions to reduce disruptions.
  • Monitor production quality across livestream sessions and recommend improvements aligned with market standards.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for livestream technical setup, studio operations, and troubleshooting.
  • Document best practices for livestream production, equipment configuration, and technical workflows.
  • Support the team in improving livestream production efficiency and scalability across multiple brands.

Team Supervision & Development

  • Supervise and mentor Production Assistants to maintain consistent livestream production standards.
  • Assign tasks and coordinate production schedules to support multiple brand livestream campaigns.
  • Train team members on studio equipment, livestream tools, and operational best practices.
  • Ensure adherence to production standards, technical workflows, and studio operational procedures.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Social Commerce Account Managers, hosts, and marketing teams to ensure livestream production aligns with brand campaign objectives.
  • Support commercial teams in delivering high-impact livestream sessions during platform campaigns and promotional events.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to maintain consistent production quality across different brands and livestream formats.
  • Contribute insights on production improvements based on livestream execution experience.

Experience & Competencies

  • 3+ years of experience in livestream production, studio operations, or video production within ecommerce, social commerce, or digital media.

  • Practical experience with camera operations, lighting setup, and audio engineering.
  • Familiarity with social commerce livestream platforms such as TikTok Shop, Shopee Live
  • Experience managing studio equipment and maintaining production inventory systems.

  • Document Control
    • Company Records: Ensure records are accurate, up-to-date, and easily accessible
    • Logistics: Manage courier services, incoming/outgoing mail, and package distribution. Act as the central point of control for document and parcel flow within the office

As part of Intrepid’s end-to-end eCommerce ecosystem, we gain broad exposure across operations, collaborate with cross-functional experts, and play a key role in shaping how brands connect with digital shoppers in real time.


The part you will play

Intrepid Asia is seeking a forward-thinking Regional AI Video Content Manager to lead the transformation of video production through artificial intelligence, agentic AI, and automation.

This role blends creative storytelling with machine learning capabilities to accelerate end-to-end video production across Southeast Asia. You will drive AI adoption within the regional video team, standardize workflows, and enable scalable, high-quality content creation for eCommerce and social commerce brands.


You are not just a video expert. You are a systems thinker who sees AI as a multiplier — improving speed, consistency, insights, and creative performance.


As a Regional AI Video Content Manager, you will take charge of:

AI-Led Video Production Strategy

  • Leverage artificial intelligence tools, agentic AI systems, and automation to accelerate video production workflows
  • Integrate creative storytelling with AI-driven processes to enhance both efficiency and output quality
  • Support the Regional Head of Video Content in implementing AI-powered strategies across Southeast Asian markets


Productivity Optimization & Operational Excellence

  • Identify bottlenecks in current video production processes and redesign workflows using AI and automation to reduce turnaround time and manual effort
  • Increase video production capacity and content output without proportional growth in headcount or cost by embedding AI tools into daily operations
  • Establish clear productivity KPIs (e.g., turnaround time, revision cycles, output volume, cost efficiency) and continuously refine systems to ensure sustainable, measurable gains across regional markets


Tool Identification & Evaluation

  • Identify and evaluate relevant AI tools for end-to-end video production, including:
    • Content ideation and scripting
    • AI-generated video production
    • Editing and post-production automation
    • Localization and adaptation
    • Performance analytics and optimization
  • Run structured testing of new tools and document learnings for regional adoption


Workflow Design & Standardization

  • Establish standardized workflows for AI-led video production across markets
  • Develop guidelines, SOPs, and best practices for AI-generated and AI-assisted video content
  • Ensure consistency in quality, compliance, and brand alignment while scaling output


Regional Implementation & Enablement

  • Partner with local market teams across SEA to implement AI-driven video production frameworks
  • Train and upskill video producers and content teams on emerging AI tools and workflows
  • Drive adoption of automation systems to improve turnaround time and reduce manual inefficiencies


Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Stay ahead of emerging AI technologies in video, generative media, automation, and analytics
  • Experiment with new AI models and tools to enhance video quality, personalization, and performance
  • Translate innovation into scalable, repeatable systems that deliver measurable impact


What we are looking for - the ideal profile

  • 5+ years of experience in video production, creative operations, or content innovation (eCommerce or social commerce preferred)
  • Strong hands-on experience with AI-powered creative tools (e.g., generative AI, AI video tools, automation platforms)
  • Proven ability to design and optimize production workflows at scale
  • Experience working across multiple Southeast Asian markets is a strong advantage
  • Strong understanding of performance-driven content and data-informed creative optimization
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to influence cross-functional and regional stakeholders
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate experimentation into scalable frameworks


In return, you will be getting

  • You will work with our portfolio of leading international brands, delivering engaging livestreams and video content to the highest standards. This role offers exposure and experience that can open many opportunities in the industry. Many of our livestream hosts have gone on to become key brand ambassadors or built followings of millions while at Intrepid — the world is truly your oyster!
  • We believe in an end to end omni-channel and full funnel approach to ensure seamless and consistent consumer journeys, and intrepid is one of the very few players who offer that full array of services under one roof. Brands love this model as it's streamlined and delivers strong performance, hence we are rapidly growing. This offers you wide exposure and exciting growth opportunities
  • We believe in the combined power of creative genius and a data-driven approach. Whether it is live streaming, video or affiliates, you will have the data and knowledge how to analyze & optimize at your fingertips, so you can add that spark of creative brilliance to create magic. With your talent and our training, we deliver high performance.
  • We are international, we know how to scale, and we are stable. Content is local, but what resonates and best practices apply across countries. Our regional exposure and teams allow us to learn faster and organize ourselves in the best way possible. You are joining a proven international company with a strong track record, but we move fast with a lot of freedom, a collaborative culture and no politics. The best of both worlds.


We also offer

Best of Both Worlds

We are a scale up: the sophistication of a small multinational, with the agility of a start-up. This means you get to work on cutting-edge projects, and besides your 'standard' job description, we love to see you show entrepreneurial initiative and want to see your take on how you can take your role and our company to the next level. Good ideas get implemented. You are the master of your own destiny.

Culture that Brings Out the Best

At Intrepid, culture is not just a buzzword, it is what we practice at work every day. We believe in collaboration over competition, transparency over politics, and willingness to learn over ego. You will be part of a team where people genuinely support one another, celebrate wins together, and face challenges head-on as one. We put our all into the work but we balance it with fun, whether that is through team lunches, after-work hangouts, events or shared laughter in the office. This is a place where you can thrive professionally while having a great time.

Grow Without Limits

Learning at Intrepid is constant and dynamic. You will have access to formal training through face-to-face sessions, coaching and our very own Intrepid Academy. On top of that, real-world experience such as leading clients, working with advanced tech, and mastering best-in-class processes will accelerate your growth every step of the way. Surrounded by a talented team that raises the bar daily, in a rapidly growing and ever-expanding business, the opportunities for your development are endless.

Rewarding You Right

We believe great work deserves great rewards at Intrepid. That’s why we offer competitive compensation and generous benefits, including comprehensive insurance and ample leave, to support you both in and out of the workplace. We want you to feel valued, cared for, and empowered to bring your best self to work every day.

The team you will be part of

Our Merchandising & Creative Team brings brands and products to life through compelling visuals and on-brand storytelling. From graphic design and content creation to product presentation and campaign assets, the team crafts experiences that captivate and convert. With a keen eye for aesthetics and a strong understanding of digital commerce, we transform ideas into visuals that drive engagement, elevate brands, and enhance the online shopping journey.


The part you will play

The Merchandiser Executive will help us deliver exceptional online shopping experiences for our clients. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the Head of Merchandising and cross-functional teams to ensure our clients' stores excel across all platforms. Your responsibilities will include optimizing product pages, driving engagement to increase traffic and conversions, and supporting AI livestream executions. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a creative mindset, this could be the ideal position for you.


As a Merchandiser Executive, you will:

  • Develop merchandising strategies and drive traffic: Create and implement strategies that enhance the shopping experience across e-commerce touchpoints (product pages, shop-in-shops, chat features) while optimizing product visibility through search keywords, compelling content, and high-quality visuals.
  • Increase and improve customer engagement: Optimize store layouts and visual hierarchy, highlight key products through effective banner sequencing, leverage the right mix of high-performing modules, and enhance engagement with clear, compelling copy to create a smooth and intuitive shopping experience.
  • Track performance and analyze competitors: Monitor key metrics such as traffic, engagement, and conversions, while conducting regular competitive benchmarking to refine strategies and ensure campaigns remain distinctive.
  • Audit and optimize platforms: Continuously assess e-commerce platforms to identify areas for improvement and ensure strategies are executed flawlessly.
  • Collaborate with creative teams: Work closely with the Graphic Design & Content teams to create visuals that align with project briefs and strategies.
  • Storyboarding and scriptwriting: Develop engaging, conversion-driven scripts and storyboards for AI powered livestreams and videos across platforms such as TikTok, Shopee, and Lazada, ensuring content aligns with brand guidelines, campaign mechanics, and resonates with the target audience.
  • Stay informed on industry trends: Keep up-to-date with the latest developments in e-commerce, livestreaming, and visual merchandising to maintain a competitive edge.


What we are looking for - the ideal profile

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Merchandising, Visual Communication, or related field
  • 2+ years of experience in ecommerce merchandising, digital marketing, campaign planning, livestream, or related roles
  • Good understanding of ecommerce platforms (e.g., Lazada, Shopee, TikTok) and content management systems
  • Strong sense of visual merchandising and understanding of what makes for a compelling online shopping experience
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Analytical mindset with keen attention to detail and the ability to interpret data to drive decision-making
  • Strong command of Excel, including the ability to create and work with complex formulas for data analysis and reporting.
  • Creative flair and passion for visual storytelling, with an eye for design and aesthetics
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and can effectively interface with cross-functional teams and articulate strategies and ideas clearly
  • A keen interest in the latest e-commerce, digital marketing, and merchandising trends to stay competitive and innovative


In return, you will be getting

  • We pride ourselves on creating visuals that both inspire and perform. At Intrepid, design is part art and part science — we’ll help you elevate your creative talent through our strong merchandising and e-commerce expertise, complemented by ongoing design and AI training to help you create work that truly makes an impact.
  • You will see your work - for some of the leading brands in the world - featured across marketplaces and social platforms
  • We offer hybrid working to strike the right balance between being 'in the zone' delivering great work undisturbed, and spending time with your colleagues to bond and learn together
  • We provide you with the best designer tools (PC/laptop/MacBook and Adobe suite) you need

By delivering on financial insights, strategic analysis, and data-driven recommendations, the team plays a critical role in guiding growth and ensuring long-term success. From planning and forecasting to optimizing performance and supporting key commercial initiatives, Our Finance team is a key partner across every function. With a strong focus on integrity, accuracy, and collaboration, its goal is to ensure the company remains financially strong, agile, and ready for the future.


As a Head of Finance, you will take charge of

  • Manage all aspects of financial analysis and business partnering functions for our Philippines businesses. 
  • Responsible for all analytical and value-added areas for the Philippines, including forecasts, management reporting & analysis, budgeting, treasury and tax filings.
  • Work with the finance team to migrate the majority of transactional accounting eg AP, AR, GL, etc to the newly established accounting centre located offshore.
  • Manage the preparation and reconciliation of all Balance sheet accounts.
  • Main contact person and liaison for all statutory, ISO and internal audits
  • Work with the Head Office team to drive process improvements in the finance function through understanding of the existing IT systems and processes and to strengthen internal controls.
  • You will report directly to the Regional CFO with a matrix reporting to the country management.  


Who we look for – the ideal profile:

  • Bachelor Degree holder in Finance or Accounting and/or member of a professional body such as ISCA, ICAEW, ACCA, CPA or equivalent, with at least 6 years’ relevant work experience in all facets of accounting and finance.
  • Possesses good business acumen and strong analytical skills including the ability to rapidly interpret, and concisely explain in a simple non-financial way.
  • Prior experience with Netsuite and a track record of automating processes as well as experience in the Retail industry, is a significant plus.
  • Strong knowledge of country corporate tax laws and company regulations.
  • Possesses exceptional organizational skills, self-motivated and possess the ability to prioritise to get things done.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, start-up and Ecommerce environment.
  • Good command of English, both spoken and written.


In return, you will be getting

  • Join an all-star Finance team which continues to raise the bar, with systems and processes (and company stability) at the level of sophistication of a small multinational, but with a 'start-up' spirit of innovation and continuous improvement in an ever-evolving world
  • In terms of learning opportunities, our organization is second to none. You will get to work on a variety of business models across many different clients as if we are 5 companies in one, and everyone is involved in projects to drive further improvement.
  • Regional teams and country Finance teams collaborate closely to ensure all finance aspects of our business are optimized, giving you a wide exposure and enhanced learning curve in a close-knit and supportive team

ad.title: Key Account Manager (E-commerce)
ad.description:
The part you will play

As a Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing and growing the ecommerce business of one or multiple brands across all ecommerce platforms As the brand’s main point of contact and trusted advisor, you create the ecommerce strategy and annual plans for your brands and take ownership of their business like it is yours. You negotiate with brand and platform stakeholders to maximize the attractiveness of propositions for consumers and exposure for the brand, in order to grow the business. You have a firm grasp of e-commerce fundamentals, digital marketing, campaign development and the growth levers that the different marketplaces offer. You coordinate with our different in-house teams and ensure that collectively you make your brand(s) successful. You are responsible for account NMV and revenue growth and work closely with the business development team to explore how your brands can benefit from additional services.


As a Key Account Manager you will take charge of 

  • Grow account NMV and revenue
  • Build strong relationships with your brand and platform counterparts 
  • Deliver expert recommendations on the best strategy / promotions / growth levers for brands
  • Develop annual growth plans and activation calendars and campaign proposals 
  • Manage cross-functional team to drive brand performance (Content, Store management, Operations, Chat) 
  • Ensure all brand / store KPIs are met
  • Collaborate on onboarding and growth plans for new brands
  • Collaborate with management on NMV goals, planning and forecasting 
  • Work together with Category Manager to ensure account retention and growth


What we are looking for - the ideal profile

  • Min 2-3  years of relevant work experience in Ecommerce, ideally with a platform (Lazada / Shopee), with another enabler, or with a brand or distributor
  • Commercial performance-driven mindset, flexible & collaborative attitude, looking to make an impact and thriving in a fast-paced start-up environment
  • Strong interpersonal, relationship and communication, listening and negotiation skills
  • Ability to develop a brand ecommerce strategy and translate this into annual & monthly activation plans
  • Experience in developing digital / ecommerce campaign plans
  • Analytical skills to analyze data and make performance improvement suggestions
  • Project management experience
  • Good Excel and PowerPoint skills


In return, you will be getting

  • We work with the most ambitious leading brands in ecommerce across South East Asia and the brand management team is the key interface between brands and our different in-house teams. In this role, you will have the most holistic overview of all facets of driving a successful e-commerce business    
  • From Junior KAM to KAM to Senior KAM to Cluster Manager and beyond, this team offers a lot of opportunities for career progression and personal development, with increasing commercial and team management responsibilities
  • Advanced systems and tools support you in running the stores of our clients, so you can focus your time on analyses, planning and initiatives that have the highest impact
  • Brand Management is a very diverse discipline, from honing your analytical and commercial skills to communication, stakeholder management and negotiation, you will get to do it all and learn from a collaborative and supportive team of experts

ad.title: AP Accountant
ad.description:
The AP Accountant will be part of Intrepid's established dedicated Accounts Payable team within the Center of Excellence (COE), providing specialized AP services across Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia, and Philippines operations. This role is critical to achieving best-in-class receivables management with full compliance to collection policies across our multi-country, multi-brand portfolio.


The role, as a part of SSC (Centre of Excellence)

Booking and Month-End Closing (40%)

  • Execute automated AP booking processes based on master data trackers across all business models (Retail Platform, Claimback, Store Management, Marketing)
  • Maintain and update master data for automation, ensuring accurate account mapping for NetSuite uploads
  • Record accruals and expenses in compliance with IFRS and internal accounting policies
  • Collaborate with the Data Automation team to operate and optimize automated booking workflows
  • Manage AP, fulfillment costs, G&A, fixed assets, bank, and marketing expenses for regional entities, including system reconciliation, journal entries, supporting schedules, and cost analysis

Dispute Resolution & Reconciliation (30%)

  • Investigate and resolve bill disputes, credit note requests, and payment discrepancies
  • Coordinate with the Operations team to perform 3-way matching (PO / Item Receipt / Bill)
  • Maintain a dispute log, tracking aging and escalation status of unresolved items
  • Support external audits with complete AP documentation

Payment Operations (20%)

  • Monitor AP aging across both retail and marketing portfolios
  • Execute payments in line with the tiered approval process
  • Maintain the payment tracker, including follow-ups, payment commitments, escalations, and resolution status
  • Coordinate with country finance teams and business teams on overdue balances and payment plans
  • Ensure consistent payment and collection policies across all business units and brands

Compliance & Reporting (10%)

  • Ensure compliance with local regulations and internal policies (Thai tax, cross-border withholding tax, intercompany policies)
  • Flag accounts breaching policy thresholds for management escalation
  • Standardize and maintain up-to-date SOPs for AP processes


What we are looking for - the ideal profile

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
  • 2 years of AP experience, preferably in shared services or multi-country operations.
  • Experience with NetSuite or similar ERP systems
  • Able to communicate in English

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets proficiency (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, formulas, data validation)
  • Experience with automated booking systems and master data management
  • Understanding of different revenue models (retail margin, consignment commission, store management fees, claimback processing)

Competencies

  • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Effective communication skills in both English and Thai (written and verbal)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities across different business units and countries
  • Customer service orientation with professional approach to collections
  • Comfortable working with cross-functional teams and external partners (audit firms, business units, country teams)

Personal Attributes

  • Self-motivated with ability to work independently
  • Process-oriented mindset with focus on compliance
  • Adaptable to changing business needs and system improvements
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability


In return, you will be getting

  • Join an all-star Finance team which continues to raise the bar, with systems and processes (and company stability) at the level of sophistication of a small multinational, but with a 'start-up' spirit of innovation and continuous improvement in an ever-evolving world
  • In terms of learning opportunities, our organization is second to none. You will get to work on a variety of business models across many different clients as if we are 5 companies in one, and everyone is involved in projects to drive further improvement.
  • Regional teams and country Finance teams collaborate closely to ensure all finance aspects of our business are optimized, giving you a wide exposure and enhanced learning curve in a close-knit and supportive team

ad.title: Live Commerce Team Lead
ad.description:
The team you will be part of

The Social Commerce Team is a fast-growing team leading the way in livestream selling, short video content, and affiliate marketing across Southeast Asia. We work with top brands, combining creativity, data, and platform expertise to drive real commercial results. As part of Intrepid’s end-to-end eCommerce ecosystem, we gain broad exposure across operations, collaborate with cross-functional experts, and play a key role in shaping how brands connect with digital shoppers in real time.


The part you will play

Intrepid, a leading eCommerce enabler in Southeast Asia, is looking for a Live Commerce Manager (Team Lead) to lead and scale our livestream business across the E-commerce platform. This role sits within the Social Commerce division and reports directly to the Head of Social Commerce, owning the end-to-end livestream strategy, execution, and performance delivery. You will be responsible for transforming livestream from an operational function into a high-performance revenue engine, driving GMV growth, optimizing production efficiency, and elevating on-screen talent and content quality.


As a Live Commerce Team Lead, you will take charge of 

Live Commerce Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and execute integrated live commerce strategies combining livestreams, short video content, and affiliate programs to maximize traffic, engagement, and GMV.
  • Partner with brand clients to define sales and marketing objectives, ensuring alignment with platform algorithms and audience behavior.
  • Manage end-to-end campaign execution — from ideation, scheduling, host coordination, and production to post-campaign performance analysis.
  • Lead the planning and optimization of livestream and video content calendars to capitalize on key events such as Double Digit Days, Payday Sales, and platform mega campaigns.
  • Strengthen creator and affiliate programs through data-backed recruitment, activation, and performance optimization of KOLs/KOCs.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Creative, Performance Marketing, and Operations teams to ensure cohesive storytelling, product readiness, and real-time fulfillment.
  • Monitor campaign analytics (e.g., CTR, Enter Room Rate, GMV, conversion) and provide actionable insights to enhance future campaign outcomes.
  • Maintain strong relationships with platform partners (TikTok, Shopee, Lazada) to stay ahead of new tools, features, and best practices.

Performance Management

  • Track and evaluate performance across all live commerce pillars using dashboards and structured reporting.
  • Create detailed performance reports and insights for internal stakeholders and clients, highlighting successes and opportunities.
  • Identify trends, competitive benchmarks, and growth opportunities to refine Intrepid’s live commerce approach.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop the Live Commerce team (Admins, MCs, Operators)
  • Set clear KPI frameworks and performance-driven culture
  • Coach and elevate MCs to improve performance
  • Drive hiring, training, and retention of high-performing livestream talent

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Performance Marketing, Content, and Operations teams to integrate livestream campaigns with broader eCommerce strategies.
  • Coordinate with the operations team to ensure real-time updates on inventory and fulfillment during livestreams.
  • Liaise with platform representatives (e.g., TikTok, Shopee, Lazada) to stay updated on new features and guidelines.

What we are looking for - the ideal profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
  • Experience: At least 5-7 years in live commerce, eCommerce, or digital marketing, with proven success in managing livestream campaigns.
  • Strong familiarity with TikTok Shop, Shopee, and Lazada platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead multi-functional teams, manage high-pressure campaign cycles, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong strategic and commercial mindset. Able to balance creativity, operations, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Excellent client management and cross-functional communication skills; comfortable collaborating with brand, creative, and platform stakeholders.
  • Adept at evaluating performance metrics, identifying insights, and steering the team toward continuous improvement.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with attention to detail.
  • Creative problem-solving skills to address real-time challenges during livestreams.
  • Passion for eCommerce and staying updated on the latest industry trends.

ad.title: Quality Control Officer (Data Centre)
ad.description:
Roles & Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Assurance & Process Compliance

  • Review and ensure all FM processes, SOPs, EOPs, workflows, and checklists comply with ISO standards, client requirements, and industry best practices.

  • Validate that operational activities align with approved procedures and the QMS framework.

  • Assist in the preparation, implementation, and improvement of quality assurance policies and guidelines.

2. QMS Support & Continuous Improvement

  • Support the Quality Manager in maintaining ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and SS 564 documentation and compliance.

  • Participate in QMS reviews, gap analysis, and process enhancement initiatives.

  • Coordinate change management for document revisions, version control, and procedural updates.

3. Audit & Compliance Monitoring

  • Assist in planning and conducting internal audits, compliance assessments, and vendor audits.

  • Track audit findings, NCRs, and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) to ensure timely closure.

  • Verify vendor service reports, statutory compliance certificates, and maintenance documentation.

4. Data Validation & Performance Monitoring

  • Analyse FM performance metrics such as PPM completion, incident response times, SLA compliance, energy consumption, downtime, and operational trends.

  • Validate accuracy of CMMS/CAFM entries, inspection logs, permit-to-work records, and maintenance data.

  • Prepare QA dashboards and reports for management and clients.

5. Vendor & Contractor Assurance

  • Ensure vendor processes, method statements, competencies, and documentation meet QA expectations before work execution.

  • Conduct random checks to ensure alignment to contract specifications and safety requirements.

  • Review and ensure close-out of service reports, service quality issues, and material compliance.

6. Incident & Risk Governance

  • Support root cause analysis for incidents, faults, and non-conformances.

  • Track incident trends and recommend preventive measures.

  • Maintain accurate records for incident reports, near-miss logs, and risk registers.

7. Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain QA records, audit logs, compliance matrices, risk logs, and QMS documents.

  • Prepare weekly/monthly QA reports highlighting issues, recurring gaps, audit results, and corrective actions.

  • Ensure documentation readiness for client audits, certification audits, and regulatory inspections.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Diploma/Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Facilities Management, Quality, or related engineering disciplines.

  • ISO 9001 Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor certificate is an advantage.

  • Familiarity with TIA-942, SS 564, SS 553, SS 568, and DC/mission-critical standards is beneficial.

Experience

  • 2–4 years of experience in FM, building services, QA/QC, industrial operations, or critical infrastructure.

  • Experience in data centres or mission-critical facilities is preferred.

  • Knowledge of key M&E systems (GRUPS, generator, chillers, switchgear, CRAC/CRAH, BMS) is desirable.

Skills

  • Strong analytical and documentation skills.

  • High attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Able to identify gaps in processes and propose improvements.

  • Effective communicator with technicians, engineers, vendors, and clients.

  • Proficient in MS Office, CAFM/CMMS, and quality reporting tools (Power BI is a plus).

Location
- Ang Mo Kio

ad.title: Shift Technician (Data Centre)
ad.description:
Roles & Responsibilities

The Rotating Shift Technician is responsible for supporting 24×7 data centre operations, ensuring the reliability, safety, and continuity of all Mechanical & Electrical (M&E), critical infrastructure, and facilities systems in accordance with approved procedures, service level agreements (SLAs), and safety requirements.

·      Perform continuous monitoring, routine patrols, and inspection of data centre infrastructure, critical facilities, and associated equipment.

·      Manage day-to-day maintenance coordination, and escalate any critical troubleshooting requirements that needs to be conducted by manufacturers.

·      Conduct routine checks of M&E and critical systems performance.

·      Record and report daily operating conditions, abnormalities, and system status.

·      Supervise and oversee OEMs, subcontractors, and service vendors performing works on electrical, mechanical, fire, and critical facilities systems.

·      Ensure all vendors deliver competent, safe, and quality services in compliance with contractual obligations, site rules, and safety requirements.

·      Coordinate and monitor scheduled and ad-hoc vendor activities, ensuring proper documentation and work completion.

·      Promptly respond to incidents, alarms, and emergency situations.

·      Execute incident escalation in accordance with approved escalation matrices and emergency response procedures.

·      Provide standby and emergency support when activated, including shift stand-in or additional coverage as required.

·     Ensure proper handover and takeover of duties during shift changes.

·      Carry out duties that comply with approved SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), MOPs (Method of Procedures), and EOPs (Emergency Operating Procedures).

·      Carry out all work strictly in accordance with site processes, operational governance, and safety regulations.

ad.description:
Roles & Responsibilities

Job Description

1.     Perform detailed cooling load calculations and thermal analysis for data halls, including rack-level heat load assessments.

2.     Design, review, and optimize ACMV systems, including:

- CRAC/CRAH units

- Chilled water systems

- Cooling towers and pumps

3.     Lead and support cooling system upgrades and retrofits, ensuring minimal disruption to live data center operations.

4.     Evaluate system performance using KPIs such as:

o  Power Usage Effectiveness

o  System Efficiency

5.     Conduct energy optimization studies and recommend improvements (e.g., air flow management, containment strategies, setpoint optimization).

6.     Support capacity planning and future expansion work based on IT load growth.

7.     Review engineering drawings, method statements, and ensure compliance with design intent and operational requirements.

8.     Work closely with operations teams to implement EOPs/MOPs for mechanical system interventions.

9.     Participate in risk assessments, failure mode analysis, and incident investigations related to cooling systems.

10.  Ensure all works comply with relevant standards and regulatory requirements in Singapore

Required Qualifications
1.     Bachelor’s Degree / Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field

2.     Additional certifications relevant to theindustry is an added advantage 

3.     1-2 years’ experience maintainingelectrical, mechanical, fire protection system in a data centre environment

4.     Experience and knowledge of MEP equipmentsuch as CAHU, CRAC, ACMV systems, pumps, cooling towers, UPS, generators, etc.

5.     Strong technical expertise in thermalmanagement, cooling load calculations, and energy efficiency improvements,supporting design and upgrading of cooling systems in data centre environments.

6.     Strong problem-solving abilities,communication skills, and the ability to work independently and as part of ateam

7.     Strong written and verbal communicationskills

8.     Proficient in Computer skills eg.Microsoft office, google emails , docs etc.

9.     Shift work & Standby Duty is required(Shift allowance available)

ad.title: Project Engineer (C&S)
ad.description:
Job Description

  • Assist the Project manager and Construction Manager in monitoring and managing the day-to-day operation of the projects.
  • To prepare method of statement, construction sequencing, sketches, and other technical submissions.
  • To monitor the execution of the site works and further review and develop the method and/or sequence of the works to ensure safety and efficiency.

  • To prepare Inspection and Test Plan, and conduct inspection and check on works performed.
  • Check the drawings discrepancies and conduct field verification, and submit technical clarification to the clients and consultants.
  • Ensure updated drawings including shop drawings are used by the site team in a timely manner.
  • Prepare site record and submit to office in a timely manner.
  • Assist the Project Manager in the preparation of reports and presentation to management, clients and stakeholders.

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Building projects and/or Geotechnical projects.
  • Conversant with local codes and authority submission procedures.
  • Familiar with precast concrete will be an added advantage.
  • Proactive, responsible and keen to work in a team.

ad.title: Senior Facility Manager
ad.description:
Roles & Responsibilities

Job Description

  • Organization, co-ordinate and control the in-house team and appointed sub-contractors. Collate and manage all technical specifications, O&M documentation, drawings and compile all maintenance programs from all sub-contractor. Track and monitor the maintenance programs by using the appropriate software and spreadsheets.
  • Manage emergency and ad-hoc repairs, breakdowns and trouble-shooting. Provide technical support and attendance where necessary and act as an Authorized Person. Manage and act as the co-ordination point between the various subcontractors and/or Vendors appointed by the Board.
  • Manage and oversee building / facilities management contracts to ensure that the service delivery and contractual obligations are delivered and executed in a manner that fosters and achieves customer satisfaction.
  • Consolidate and provide technical reports or findings to the Board.
  • Oversee the health and safety management. Ensure Permit- to-Work (PTW) is approved and proper submission of all risk assessment reports by all sub-contractors, including those appointed by the Board, before the works are executed, proper filing of the reports and implement inspection and spot checks to ensure compliance to risk assessment by the sub-contractors.
  • Works management such as preparing monthly progress reports, certification of work completed to the required standard, issue and control of variation orders, etc.
  • Assist in the day to day ‘running’ of the Property.
  • Carry out periodical and statutory inspections in an agreed format and manner with the Board and provision of management reports thereafter.
  • Shall manage customer service-related issues, ensure proper response and action items with customers (any tenants / Occupant / staff or members of public) are closed in a timely and professional manner.
  • Also be responsible for the office management functions, office support services and administrative support to the Board.
  • Any other work necessary for effective operations of the Property.

Job Requirements

  • Degree from recognized tertiary establishment in Facility Management / Mechanical Engineering/ Electrical Engineering/ Building Services.
  • 5 years relevant experience in Facilities Operation in FM service provider
  • Good interpersonal soft skills and verbal & written communication.
  • Good working knowledge and understanding of maintenance and contracts.
  • FSM / SCEM /other FM and Safety related certificates will have added advantage
  • Location: Marina Barrage

  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a keen attention to detail.
  • Location is at Shan Road
  • 5.5 work day

ad.title: Mechanical Technician
ad.description:
Overview

Element has an opportunity for a Mechanical Technician to join our growing team. This is a great opportunity to develop your career within a Global TIC business.


Responsibilities

  • Interpretation of internal and client requirements
  • Supervising allocated staff and being responsible for the day to day management of the relevant discipline
  • Operating complex mechanical testing equipment
  • Maintaining accurate and systematic records
  • Performing other duties to fulfil the demands of the laboratory
  • Performing general duties in accordance with Element's internal procedures, quality as well as Health and Safety system
  • Application of instrumentation and the setting up of complex data capture equipment
  • Report writing, data interpretation and analysis

Skills / Qualifications

  • Educated to a good general standard including English and Maths
  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or relevant / experience in related (testing laboratory)
  • Hands-on job
  • Sound mechanical bias
  • Previous experience in an appropriate Engineering environment is a distinct advantage
  • Experience of working within a Mechanical testing environment is advantageous
  • An understanding of a recognised Quality Management Systems such as ISO 17025 is beneficial
  • Self motivated Technician with the ability to multi task, organise and work under the pressure of a busy commercial mechanical test laboratory
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • A team player attitude
  • Excellent analytical and problem solving skills

#LI-CL1


Company Overview

Element is one of the fastest growing testing, inspection and certification businesses in the world. Globally we have more than 9,000 brilliant minds operating from 270 sites across 30 countries. Together we share an ambitious purpose to ‘Make tomorrow safer than today’.

When failure in use is not an option, we help customers make certain that their products, materials, processes and services are safe, compliant and fit for purpose. From early R&D, through complex regulatory approvals and into production, our global laboratory network of scientists, engineers, and technologists support customers to achieve assurance over product quality, sustainable outcomes, and market access.

While we are proud of our global reach, working at Element feels like being part of a smaller company. We empower you to take charge of your career, and reward excellence and integrity with growth and development.

Industries across the world depend on our care, attention to detail and the absolute accuracy of our work. The role we have to play in creating a safer world is much bigger than our organization.

Diversity Statement

At Element, we always take pride in putting our people first. We are an equal opportunity employer that recognizes diversity and inclusion as fundamental to our Vision of becoming “the world’s most trusted testing partner”.

 

All suitably qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment on the basis of objective work related criteria and without regard for the following: age, disability, ethnic origin, gender, marital status, race, religion, responsibility of dependents, sexual orientation, or gender identity or other characteristics in accordance with the applicable governing laws or other characteristics in accordance with the applicable governing laws.

ad.title: Chemistry Technician
ad.description:
Overview

Element has an opportunity for a Chemistry Technician for testing, sample preparation and delivery/collection of samples and preparation of test reports.

Responsibilities

  • Analysis of water-physical, chemical and microbiological parameters
  • Analysis of ores and minerals
  • Analysis of water, soil, aggregates, concrete and scale samples
  • Operation of equipment like pH / EC / TDS meters, UV-visible spectrophotometers, ovens, furnaces, incubators, fusion machines
  • Prepare the reagents, standard solution and ensure standardisation of the solution used in the laboratory
  • Handling and storage all chemicals as per the Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS)
  • Managing the calibration of glass wares and the instruments
  • Performance of qualitative and quantitative laboratory tests and analysis of other substances as per standard method
  • Issue reports and receive samples to and from the respective entities
  • Involvement in site and field testing with various international standards or in-house procedures
  • Ensure work compliance to ISO 17025 requirements
  • Coordinating with the other technicians in the team to carry out work as per the planning schedule
  • Manual handling of samples
  • General maintenance, cleaning and checking of equipment
  • Working to all HSE standards
  • Interaction with clients during witnessed testing
  • Generating test reports for clients (data entry, quality assurance)
  • Ensuring compliance to all Element Material Technology quality standards
  • Driving to customer site to collect samples and / or conduct testing at their lab on a regular / daily basis
  • Willing to assist in other activities from time to time that may be requested by the department manager to assist in the execution of Element Material Technology annual targets and budget

Skills / Qualifications

  • Have a diploma / degree in chemistry with at least 2 years experience in similar role
  • Have the ability to work in teams under pressure and flexible to work different working hours (night / day) shifts if required or necessary
  • Good English communication skills: reading, writing, speaking
  • Good maths skills
  • Knowledge and experience of safe operation of testing equipment and operating in an independent / chemistry / consultant laboratory

ad.title: Associate Test Technician
ad.description:
Overview

Element has an opportunity for Associate Test Technician to join our rapidly expanding team. As a member of the operations team in one of the various laboratories across Element, the Associate Test Technician position performs a variety of routine and non-routine testing assignments within the department assigned and insures timely and accurate test results under direct supervision.

The technician positions must be proficient in a number of core business skills including but not limited to compliance to established safety rules, code of conduct, and company policies and procedures.


Responsibilities

  • Perform varies of construction testing onsite such as concrete, soil, structural fixings and etc.
  • Perform test as directed by customer specification / Engineer’s instruction
  • Operate testing independently and /or under supervision of senior test technician
  • Gather and record test data and able to communicates properly with client onsite.
  • Prepare and compile reports/worksheets as per supervisor’s instruction

Skills / Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of laboratory safety & site safety.
  • HS diploma or GED certificate preferred. College or vocational school coursework welcomed
  • 0-2 years’ experience in a testing related field
  • Basic understanding of testing concepts
  • Possess computer skills.
  • Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry a plus

Physical Demands

  • Frequency of required physical force: Minimum (moderate).
  • Lifting requirements: lifting <50 lbs. often and > 50 lbs. on occasion
  • Ability to stand on feet for long periods of time
  • Ability to lift 50+lbs periodically

Company Overview

ad.title: Engineer
ad.description:
Overview

Element has an opportunity for an Engineer to join our rapidly expanding team. As a member of the operations team, the Engineer position performs a variety of routine and non-routine testing assignments within the department assigned and insures timely and accurate test results under minimal direct supervision.

The engineer position must be proficient in a number of core business and technical skills including but not limited to compliance to established safety rules, code of conduct, and company policies and procedures.


Responsibilities

  • In charge of operation of NDT testing for Concrete buildings materials includes test arrangement, testing and reporting.
  • Provides counsel to coworkers and customers requiring critical analysis of data.
  • Be responsible for SINGLAS Accreditation.
  • Assist in the professional development of novice technicians and engineers
  • Utilizes an assortment of skills, methods, procedures and materials in advanced testing analysis.
  • Capable to read/translate construction drawings and technical requirement in reaching testing conclusions.
  • Confident making both formal and information presentations on conventional and/or routine testing to a wide range of stakeholders
  • Review test report and ensure all laboratory are in constant state of regulatory compliance and inspection readiness.
  • Develop training material and deliver technical training to laboratory colleagues.

Skills / Qualifications

  • Possess minimum a Bachelor Degree in Civil Engineering or Material Science. Fresh graduate is welcome.
  • Working knowledge of construction site and laboratory safety will be beneficial.
  • Possesses a wealth of knowledge, deep awareness and critical understanding related to the scope, core theories, concepts, terminologies and boundaries of civil engineering discipline
  • Has a depth of specialty knowledge and understanding in multiple areas of civil engineering discipline
  • Possesses a demonstrated ability to apply academic knowledge within the context of Element’s business
  • Possess strong computer skills and auto-cad.
  • Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry a plus
  • Possess class 3 driving license is a plus

ad.title: Data Processor (MY)
ad.description:
Overview

Element has an opportunity for a Data Processor to join our rapidly expanding team. As a member of the operations team in one of the various laboratories across Element, the Data Processer position primarily responsible for assisting in designing, planning, and coordinating geotechnical instrumentation projects, scheduling control, obtaining permits for on-site installation, and setting up and commissioning monitoring.

This role is based in Johor Bahru, Malaysia.


Responsibilities

  • Receive and review field data (borehole logs, CPT, SPT, rock coring, etc.) from site engineers/ geologist.
  • Compile lab test results (e.g., moisture content, Atterberg limits, triaxial, consolidation tests).
  • Validate data accuracy against site records and laboratory logs
  • Generate borehole logs using software such as AutoCAD, Geosmart
  • Work closely with geotechnical engineers, drafters, lab technicians, and field staff & follow up with external laboratories or drilling contractors for missing data or clarifications.
  • Data processing for field test such as Permeability Test, Packer Test, Pressuremeter Test, Vane Shear Test, CPT
  • Align reports with project specifications, national standards (e.g., ASTM, BS, IS codes), and local regulatory requirements
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot inconsistencies in data.
  • Familiarity with common soil types in Singapore
  • Ability to work under pressure to meet submission deadlines
  • Update project managers on report status and highlight any delays or issues
  • Support revisions and feedback from engineers and clients promptly and professionally
  • Perform quality checks on all data inputs and report outputs

Skills / Qualifications

  • Minimum Degree in Civil Engineering or Geotechnical Engineering or Geology
  • Working experience in geotechnical instrumentation and site investigation works would be advantageous
  • Able to withstand the challenging working conditions
  • Strong and determined quality focus with indefatigable determination to get the job done under the most challenging conditions
  • Self-motivated team player with excellent organisational and communication skills

  • Provide technical and engineering leadership, and supports the development of new technologies within a local laboratory
  • Be accountable for accurate and timely release of testing data to customers including sign-offs of quality control data as acceptable

ad.title: Quantity Surveyor
ad.description:
Overview

Element has an opportunity for a Quantity Surveyor to join our growing team. This is a great opportunity to develop your career within a Global TIC business.

This role is based in Johor Bahru

Responsibilities

  • Prepare technical and commercial proposals during tender stage including bills of quantities material quantity and taking off quantities, attend site show round, site visit, attend tender briefing, seeks clarifications with respective client/ consultant if any.
  • Study details and discuss with management, attend tender interviews including method statement, technical proposal presentation and tender clarification.
  • Manpower and resources budgeting, monthly monitoring, review and update.
  • Prepare pricing of bill of quantity and re-measurement works.
  • Assist in establishing a client's requirements and coordinate quality controls to ensure deliverables meet requirements.
  • Monitor tender/quotation results, check tender/quotation status via Gebiz and inform management; for private tender/quotation, to follow-up closely with client.
  • Collaborate with client for kick off meeting and attend kick off meeting with project team Prepare handing over and brief project details scope with project team, review contract documents.
  • Evaluate and handle all contractual issues, variation orders, insurances/bond and render support/advice to project team.
  • Conduct cost analysis, manage project timeline and cost conduct commercial negotiations.
  • Attending site visit to monitor site progress and performance.
  • In charge of preparing progress claim submission, variation orders to client and handling subcontractors’ claims.
  • Call for a quotation from supplier and/or subcon if necessary.
  • Assist in material/equipment procurement, inventory, and general administration task other duties as may be assigned on a need basis requirement.
  • Preparation of technical details & costing for tender submission.
  • Handle progress claims and progress payment, verifying payment to sub-contractors, ensuring all variations to contract are captured and tracking variation orders.
  • Conduct cost analysis, manage project timeline and cost, conduct commercial negotiations.
  • Liaise and establish rapport with consultants, quantity surveyors, developers, and contractors on certification of claims for payments.
  • Other ad-hoc duties as assigned.

Skills / Qualifications

  • Diploma or Degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum 2–3 years in QS or cost management roles; experience in building or M&E projects preferred.

Skills:

  • Strong knowledge of cost estimation, tendering, and contract administration.
  • Familiarity with standard forms of contract
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel) and QS software
  • Excellent analytical, negotiation, and communication skills.
  • Professional Membership preferred

  • Perform Calibration and Measurement of Dimension gauges and instruments as per WI using CMM, reference master, tester etc (on-site and in-house) with report and necessary administrative work

ad.title: Associate Chemist
ad.description:
Overview

Element has an opportunity for a Chemistry Technician for testing, sample preparation and delivery/collection of samples and preparation of test reports.

Responsibilities

  • Analysis of water-physical, chemical and microbiological parameters
  • Analysis of ores and minerals
  • Analysis of water, soil, aggregates, concrete and scale samples
  • Operation of equipment like pH / EC / TDS meters, UV-visible spectrophotometers, ovens, furnaces, incubators, fusion machines
  • Prepare the reagents, standard solution and ensure standardisation of the solution used in the laboratory
  • Handling and storage all chemicals as per the Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS)
  • Managing the calibration of glass wares and the instruments
  • Performance of qualitative and quantitative laboratory tests and analysis of other substances as per standard method
  • Issue reports and receive samples to and from the respective entities
  • Involvement in site and field testing with various international standards or in-house procedures
  • Ensure work compliance to ISO 17025 requirements
  • Coordinating with the other technicians in the team to carry out work as per the planning schedule
  • Manual handling of samples
  • General maintenance, cleaning and checking of equipment
  • Working to all HSE standards
  • Interaction with clients during witnessed testing
  • Generating test reports for clients (data entry, quality assurance)
  • Ensuring compliance to all Element Material Technology quality standards
  • Driving to customer site to collect samples and / or conduct testing at their lab on a regular / daily basis
  • Willing to assist in other activities from time to time that may be requested by the department manager to assist in the execution of Element Material Technology annual targets and budget

Skills / Qualifications

  • Have a diploma / degree in chemistry with at least 2 years experience in similar role
  • Have the ability to work in teams under pressure and flexible to work different working hours (night / day) shifts if required or necessary
  • Good English communication skills: reading, writing, speaking
  • Good maths skills
  • Knowledge and experience of safe operation of testing equipment and operating in an independent / chemistry / consultant laboratory

ad.title: IoT Engineer
ad.description:
Overview

Element is looking for a skilled and proactive IoT Engineer to assess, implement, and maintain IoT-based geotechnical instrumentation systems. In this role, you will be responsible for selecting and integrating sensors and communications devices, managing data pipelines, and ensuring reliable data acquisition for structural and geotechnical monitoring. This role bridges hardware deployment, cloud integration, and data integrity, supporting real-time alerting and reporting systems for engineering decision-making.

 

This role is based in Kaki Bukit, Singapore.

Responsibilities

Sensor setup and system design

  • Design, implement and maintain IoT sensor networks and data acquisition systems for geotechnical applications (e.g., piezometers, inclinometers, strain gauges, total stations, etc.)
  • Identify and specify field data acquisition hardware such as nodes, loggers and gateways & select, assess, configure, and maintain sensors and communication devices for accurate data acquisition

Data Acquisition, Transformation, and Management

  • Build and manage data pipelines from edge devices to cloud on on-premise-hosted databases & implement transformation logic for raw sensor data based on project-specific rules
  • Ensure data quarantine and release workflows, and alert rules and escalations are correctly programmed and integrated & collaborate with field teams to set up data monitoring systems for projects
  • Ensure secure data transmission and storage using best practices & monitor system health and uptime of IoT infrastructure

Collaboration & Reporting

  • Work with IT Engineers and other Instrumentation Engineers and Surveyors to develop dashboards and ensure seamless data flow & support reporting automation and data visualization efforts
  • Provide technical documentation and training for field teams and stakeholders

Skills / Qualifications

  • Diploma or Degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field

  • Certifications in IoT, data engineering, cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), or communications protocols are a plus

    Skills & Experience

  • Experience with IoT protocols (MQTT, FTP), sensor integration, and embedded systems

  • Familiarity with SQL databases, data transformation logic, and cloud services

  • Knowledge of geotechnical instrumentation is highly desirable

  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills in field deployments and data flow
